architecture_style: static site (existing Vite frontend, single-file text edit)
frontend: Existing Vite frontend project; locate the homepage component/markup containing the current heading and change only the text content to 'Milestone 8 Live Deployment Test', preserving existing tags, classes, and styling.
testing_strategy: Run the existing Vite build/dev server to confirm the project still compiles and starts without errors; visually or via a simple render check confirm the homepage heading displays exactly 'Milestone 8 Live Deployment Test' with no other visual or functional regressions.
technical_constraints: No changes to styling, layout, or functionality other than the heading text
No new dependencies, files, or components should be introduced
Preserve existing HTML structure/tag and CSS class on the heading element
rationale: This is a one-line content change to an existing static Vite frontend, so no new architecture, backend, or data layer is warranted. The only risk is scope creep or accidental breakage, so the spec constrains the change to the heading text itself and requires a basic build/render check to confirm nothing else was affected.
